# CSVBox

CSVBox provides APIs for configuring spreadsheet importers and submitting spreadsheet files to connected destinations.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/csvbox/.

## Actions

- **Create CSVBox Sheet**: Create a CSVBox importer sheet.
- **Submit CSVBox File Import**: Submit a publicly accessible spreadsheet URL to a CSVBox sheet for asynchronous delivery.
- **Update CSVBox Sheet**: Partially update an existing CSVBox importer sheet while preserving omitted top-level fields.
- **Verify CSVBox Credentials** (read-only): Verify the connected CSVBox API credentials and return the associated profile.
